appDescription: Rear-seat collecting game. Reports the egg the child is incubating and suggests destinations with unseen species.

function.name: REPORT_EGG_STATUS
function.description: Tell the driver what egg the rear-seat child is incubating, its progress, and whether smoother driving would help.

function.name: SUGGEST_DESTINATION
function.description: Suggest a nearby place in a region (coast, mountain, city) where an unseen species appears, nearest first, and offer to set it as the navigation destination. Call again without confirm when the driver wants a different place.

confirm.description: true when the driver accepted the suggestion and the destination should be set.

function.name: CELEBRATE_HATCH
function.description: Announce to the driver that the egg has hatched and which species appeared.
